name: Recraft
tagline: AI image generation tuned for designers and brand work
description: Recraft is a text-to-image platform built around design workflows. Its V3 model (Recraft V3) tops the Artificial Analysis image arena and supports vector output, brand style training, infinite-canvas layout, and precise text rendering. Designers can train custom styles, lock palettes, and generate consistent assets across a campaign.
pricingDetails: Free: 50 daily credits. Basic: $12/month. Advanced: $33/month. Pro: $66/month. Enterprise: custom.
